Job Summary
 We are seeking a motivated and skilled Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience in developing modern web applications using React or Angular and Spring Boot. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, REST API integration, authentication mechanisms, and database-driven applications.
The candidate will work closely with product owners, architects, and development teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality applications in an Agile environment.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications using React/Angular and Spring Boot.
Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly UI components.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs.
Implement authentication and authorization solutions using industry-standard protocols.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver business requirements.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to application design discussions.
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in development and production environments.
Ensure application performance, reliability, and security best practices.
Contribute to CI/CD processes and deployment activities.
Follow Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
 Required Skills
 Frontend
Strong experience with React or Angular
JavaScript / TypeScript
HTML5, CSS3
Responsive Web Application Development
Experience building reusable UI components
Familiarity with state management libraries such as:
Redux
NgRx
Context API
Understanding of frontend performance optimization
 Backend
Java 11/17+
Spring Boot
Spring Security
REST API Development
Hibernate / JPA
Basic understanding of Microservices Architecture
API integration and troubleshooting
 Authentication & Authorization
JWT Authentication
OAuth 2.0 fundamentals
Single Sign-On (SSO) concepts
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Understanding of secure session and token management
 Database & DevOps
Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL
Database design and query optimization
Hands-on experience with Git/Bitbucket, SourceTree, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
CI/CD fundamentals
Maven
Basic Docker knowledge
 Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure or AWS
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools
Experience working on enterprise applications
Understanding of design patterns and clean code principle
 Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
Minimum 4 years of hands-on software development experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Nice to Have
Experience with Microsoft ecosystem and Azure services
Exposure to cloud-native application development
Understanding of API security best practices
Basic knowledge of performance tuning and application monitoring
Experience supporting applications in production environments
